items.name: Forty-Two: Redwood End-Grain Wall Art
items.description:
Handcrafted from 42 individual redwood blocks, Forty-Two transforms reclaimed lumber into a striking geometric composition. Dense growth rings, warm heartwood, natural color variations, and subtle imperfections form an intricate pattern within a rugged, weathered wooden frame.

Each block reveals a different chapter of the tree’s growth, creating a one-of-a-kind piece that celebrates the character and history of natural wood. 25”x22”

items.name: The Claw - Sculptural Wood & Stone
items.description:
celebration of nature’s untamed forms, Undertow pairs richly figured wood with a dark, naturally textured stone base. Sweeping grain, intricate folds, and weathered cavities reveal dramatically different compositions from every angle.

A one-of-a-kind sculpture where the movement of wood meets the stillness of stone.

items.name: Live Edge Palo Santo
items.description: A handcrafted palo santo holder featuring warm golden wood, natural contours, and flowing grain. A custom steel plate and upright rest create an industrial contrast, allowing the wood's unique character to remain the centerpiece.

items.name: Tides — Large Sculptural Wooden Bowl
items.description:
Carved from a substantial piece of naturally figured hardwood, Tides celebrates the movement and character of the original timber. Flowing contours, dramatic grain patterns, natural cracks, and an organically carved basin create a sculptural centerpiece that blurs the line between functional woodworking and fine art.

Why this price: The unusual asymmetrical shape and substantial hardwood construction make it more of a statement piece than a conventional wooden bowl. I would sell it primarily as decorative art.

items.name: Relic — Extra-Long Mahogany Catchall
items.description: Hand-carved from a substantial length of solid mahogany, Relic contrasts a smooth, refined exterior with a rustic, textured interior. Natural beetle galleries, contrasting tones, and distinctive surface markings preserve the wood's history, creating an elegant catchall for everyday essentials or a striking decorative centerpiece.

items.name: Forest Fire Burned Cedar Candle Holder
items.description: A dramatic sweep of naturally weathered wood rises above slender brass supports, creating a striking balance of movement and form. A polished brass tea light cup rests within the organic structure, contrasting beautifully with the rich grain, rugged textures, and natural imperfections of the wood.

items.name: Mounted Wood Sculpture
items.description: A naturally sculptural piece of figured wood elevated on a minimalist steel pedestal. Intricate grain patterns, flowing contours, and organic imperfections create a striking contrast between nature and modern metalwork.

items.name: Rustic Feather Holder
items.description: A rustic decorative holder crafted from naturally weathered wood, preserving its textured bark, splits, and exposed grain. Designed to display feathers while celebrating the raw beauty and history of the timber.

items.name: Mahogany Catchall
items.description: Hand-carved from solid mahogany, this substantial catchall combines a deliberately rustic interior with a smooth, refined exterior. Natural beetle tracks and contrasting wood tones give every surface distinctive character.

items.name: Weathered Sculptural Bowl
items.description: An organically shaped wooden bowl featuring deeply textured grain, weathered contours, and striking natural color variation. Its distinctive form transforms an imperfect piece of wood into a one-of-a-kind decorative vessel.

items.name: Burrel Palo Santo
items.description: A handcrafted palo santo holder featuring richly figured wood with swirling knots and natural voids. A custom steel resting plate provides a striking industrial contrast to the warm, organic wooden base.
